summary_en: 30,000 shares (2.16% of shares outstanding) buyback authorization. Upper limit in yen, execution window, price ceiling, and method per original July 31 notice. Correction: percentage of shares outstanding revised from 2.14% to 2.16%.
title_en: (Corrected) Partial Correction to Notice Regarding Determination of Treasury Share Acquisition Matters
translation_en_brief: This is a corrective filing issued August 3, 2026, amending the treasury share acquisition notice published July 31, 2026. NOVA SYSTEM identified a calculation error in the percentage of shares outstanding represented by the 30,000-share buyback authorization. The percentage has been corrected from 2.14% to 2.16% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury shares). All other terms—share count (30,000 maximum), upper limit in yen, execution window, price ceiling, and method (ToSTNeT-3)—remain as stated in the original July 31 announcement and are referenced in this correction notice without repetition.
